verdict.rationale: Loops ships a first-party remote MCP server (mcp.loops.so) that lets Claude or any MCP client manage contacts, mailing lists, events and transactional email through natural-language requests. It also offers installable agent skills so a coding agent can "use Loops for you," including an example of an agent migrating sends and templates. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface (NL use depends on an external agent client), and independent or hands-on corroboration that NL operation works in practice.
